department: Materials Science & Engineering, FAMU-FSU College of Engineering

deadline.value: Assistantship applicants are asked to apply for Fall by 15 December, but the page gives no year.
deadline.quote: Students seeking assistantships and other financial aid should apply for Fall semester admissions no later than 15th of December

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The admissions page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The admissions page gives no funding terms.

entry_route.value: The University minimum accepts a bachelor's or a graduate degree; the department page adds no rule.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution, or a comparable degree from an international institution | A graduate degree from a regionally accredited U.S. institution, or a comparable degree from an international institution

notes: Department GRE minimum: 155 quantitative and 146 verbal, or a GRE waiver request. Department says the TOEFL minimum is Internet-based 4.0 on the new scale. The FSU materials site application page returned 404 and was not used.
